notes:
BUDGET: I ran 14 WebSearch calls against an allowance of 12, i.e. 2 over (the extra two were the UK-YMS and F-4-R queries). WebFetch was not used. Most verdicts rest on the verbatim decree and manual text already in the repo: data/visadocs.yaml (2026 manual lists), findings.md (decree text read from law.go.kr by earlier verifiers) and round2 files (research_R2b's MOJ extracts).

KEY CORRECTIONS for the engine:
(1) F-5-1 degree condition: applies only when the status held AT APPLICATION is E-7 or D-10 (visadocs onlyKo 'D-10, E-7'). Earlier E-7 years count without a degree once the person holds e.g. F-2-99.
(2) F-5-5: the '6 continuous months' document is a D-9 extension document, not part of F-5-5.
(3) F-5-14: an unavoidable change of employer within 3 months to the same industry does not reset the count.
(4) E-10: the cap is 3 years from first entry, 4y10m total with re-employment (2026 manual). Same as E-9.
(5) E-7-4R entry: 2 years in 10 on E-9/E-10/H-2 (manual); E-7-4 stays 4 in 10.
(6) F-2-T: the 1-year/2× GNI test is only the in-Korea change route; F-2-T from abroad needs the full criteria and no Korean period. Rule 91 and discrepancy 8 adjusted.
(7) Top-Tier: the PhD + 5 years (3 at a world-class research institute) alternative is official since the 2026 expansion; PR (F-5-T) after 3 years.
(8) F-5-S1: 3 years on F-2-7S (university notices).
(9) D-10-1 does not universally imply a degree, because of the points-exempt groups.
(10) D-2-4 alone should imply only edu 3, since integrated-course students enter with a bachelor's.
(11) F-2-R language level: likely relaxed to TOPIK 3 / KIIP 3 in 2026, as the data already says.

CONFIRMED: the D-10-1 caps (60-79 points: 1 year in 6-month grants; 80+: 3 years in 1-year grants, since 2025-10-29), the E-9 4y10m per entry, the F-2-99 status list, the F-5 decree periods (2/2/2/3/3/3/5/5 etc.), and F-2-5's three cases.

UNRESOLVED:
- D-4-1 total cap: only a 2-year per-grant cap was found.
- D-10-2, D-10-3 and D-10-T total caps (the data uses 2).
- D-10 total cap for points-exempt Korean-university graduates.
- H-2 4y10m cap: unverified.
- D-2 course lengths: 고등교육법 text not retrieved; only the integrated 4+ years and a 2-year master's at one university were seen.
- All 시행규칙 별표 1 per-grant caps.
- F-5-1 and F-2-99 continuity/absence rules: practitioner sources conflict (3 months on a re-entry permit vs 90 days per trip / 180 days per year; 30-day re-entry for F-2-99).
- F-5-7 naturalization periods: not re-fetched.
- F-5-13: age 60 and the pension amount not verified.
- E-6-2 inside the F-5-1 range: by the decree's letter E-6-2 counts; no manual carve-out was found.
- F-5-18, F-5-S2 and F-5-29 principal waiting periods: no source found. The decree's 2-year own-stay rule for family (제2호) suggests no waiting period on the principal, but these codes may fall under other items.

Sources used directly: seoulstart.com, kowork.kr (D-10); seoulstart F-2-7 guide; hankyung.com 202501108819i (E-9); cse.snu.ac.kr notice 25087, yonsei.ac.kr 943406, eng.jnu.ac.kr (K-STAR); moj.go.kr/bbs/moj/189/607924 (Top-Tier); lawwin.co.kr index=2759 (F-4-R); seoulstart/klawguru H-1 guides; mse.snu.ac.kr and sw.ajou.ac.kr (course lengths).
